title: Speaking with Care
paragraphs: During a team meeting, Salma disagrees with a colleague's idea. Instead of criticizing it harshly, she chooses her words carefully and explains her concern calmly, focusing on the idea itself rather than the person.

Her colleague listens and even appreciates the honest feedback, since it was delivered respectfully. After the meeting, another teammate tells Salma that her calm and thoughtful tone made the whole discussion feel productive rather than tense.

Salma admits that speaking this way does not always come naturally to her, especially when she strongly disagrees with something, but she has practiced pausing for a few seconds before responding in any heated discussion.
She remembers a saying she learned growing up: speak good, or remain silent. She realizes that this simple principle helps her build trust at work, even when she needs to disagree with someone.
